exec_command.description: The executable command (D-Bus name or binary path) to launch the application

try_exec_command.description: Command used to check if the application is installed before launching

terminal.description: Whether the application should be run in a terminal

no_display.description: Whether to hide this entry from menus and launchers

startup_notify.description: Whether to send startup notification events

startup_wm_class.description: WM class to match for startup notification and taskbar association

gnome_autostart_notify.description: GNOME autostart: whether to send notify after startup

gnome_autostart_phase.description: GNOME autostart phase (e.g., SessionInitialization, Desktop, Application)

gnome_auto_restart.description: GNOME autostart: whether to automatically restart the service if it exits unexpectedly
